tagline: Top rated Insurance Coverage attorney in Dallas, Texas

about: R. Brent Cooper attended law school and graduated from Southern Methodist University Dedman School of Law in 1977. Brent Cooper began practicing law in 1977.
Brent Cooper is an attorney at Cooper & Scully, P.C., helping people with Insurance Coverage issues. Cooper & Scully, P.C. has an office in Dallas, Texas, serving the local community.

Brent Cooper was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
